name: Opacity Correction for Slice Count Invariance
aliases: Opacity Correction for Variable Slice Counts
definition: Scales per-slice opacity to maintain constant image intensity regardless of the number of rendered slices.
summary: Opacity Correction for Slice Count Invariance is a direct volume ray casting technique that maintains constant image intensity by scaling per-sample opacity inversely to the slice count, unlike standard compositing which causes brightness artifacts when sampling density changes.
